answers.value: Weight of the ruler W = 0.5 N
answers.scheme: Diagram: scale X (0) to Y (100), 2 N down at 0, W down at 50, fulcrum at 70, 5 N down at 100. By principle of moments about the fulcrum: \((2 \times 70) + (W \times 20) = 5 \times 30\) \(\therefore 20W = 150 - 140 = 10\) \(\therefore W = 0.5\) N.
